description: Gates and checks that must have run at least once in the JavaScript engine of the conformance run; run_py.py --compare exits 2 on a count of zero. These are the text checks only JavaScript runs until their Python twins land (Q6), which register under their own check id: VA1, VA3, VA4, VA6, VA7, VA8, the D8 spec checks, the C2 additions, and D10.glyph-icon (a text check inside the rendered gate D10). The comparison derives the same list from qa-rules.json per check; this list is the second, written-down copy, and a unit test keeps the two equal.
